referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A fixed left sidebar with search, section links, thumbnails, contact details, and a copyright line. The main column opens with a split editorial hero: a serif headline and short paragraph on the left, a portrait photograph on the right, and an outlined action. A four-icon feature grid follows, then a two-column article grid with images and outlined More actions. The palette is white, warm gray, and coral red; the display face is a high-contrast serif with a neutral sans body.
